BiblicalUsage: Merowts is the race, the trial of speed, and Ecclesiastes 9:11 says the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, nor bread to the wise, but time and chance happeneth to them all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the race is not won by the fastest because God is the one who orders the outcome, and time and chance are His servants, not His rivals.
